plan.title: Content ki Lambai aur Depth Barhayein
plan.detail: Aapki site par sirf 331 alfaz hain jabkay competitors average 2286 alfaz likh rahe hain. Topic ko mukammal tafseel se cover karein aur content ko kam az kam 1500 se 2000 alfaz tak le kar jayein taakay Google aapko comprehensive resource samjhe.

plan.title: Optimized Images aur Visual Media Shamil Karein
plan.detail: Aapke page par filhal 0 images hain jabkay muqable ki sites par average 76 images hain. Relevant diagrams, infographics aur charts add karein. Har image par targeted Alt tag lagana zaroori hai.

plan.title: Internal Linking Network Mazboot Banayein
plan.detail: Muqable ki sites mein average 153 internal links hain jabkay aapke paas sirf 5 hain. Apni site ke doosre mutalliqah pages aur guides ke contextual links shamil karein taakay link authority flow ho sake.

plan.title: Headings (H2 aur H3) ka Istemal Barhayein
plan.detail: Competitors ke paas 10 H2 tags hain aur aapke paas 5. User ke mukhtalif sawalat ko target karte hue mazeed sub-headings (jaise faide, steps, common mistakes vaghera) shamil karein taakay content structure behtar ho.

plan.title: FAQ Section aur Schema Markup Add Karein
plan.detail: Content ke aakhir mein 4 se 5 ahem sawalat ka FAQ section banayein aur FAQPage Structured Data (Schema) implement karein taakay Google search results mein rich snippets haasil ho sakein.

plan.title: Naye Media par Speed aur Lazy Loading Maintain Karein
plan.detail: Aapki current speed behtareen hai (LCP 0.8s, Performance 99). Nayi images add karte waqt Next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF) aur Lazy Loading lazmi istemal karein taakay speed drop na ho.
